title: hieracium caledonicum subsp. veterascens
intro: Hieracium caledonicum subsp. veterascens, commonly known as the Rough Hawk's-beard, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health issues. The plant has been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium caledonicum subsp. veterascens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its health benefits.
